title: Onboarding Flow, Meeting Intelligence Agent & Q3 Budget Review
discussion_points: Sarah's team completed wireframes for the new onboarding flow; design team provided feedback on mobile layout requiring another revision round estimated at 3-4 days.
Anas's team can begin back-end API endpoint setup in parallel using the existing database schema from the old flow, estimated at one week.
Omar proposed building a meeting intelligence agent that auto-generates structured minutes from recordings/notes and pushes action items to Planner.
Omar needs access to Azure Speech API and SharePoint templates to build the proof of concept; two-week timeline considered tight but feasible.
Q3 budget review is scheduled for next Monday; all department heads must submit estimates by Friday.
decisions: Sarah will own the wireframe revisions and hand them off to developers by Thursday.
Anas's team will begin back-end API development in parallel with the wireframe revisions.
Omar's meeting intelligence agent proof of concept is made a priority with a two-week deadline.
Azure resources will be provisioned for Omar by tomorrow.
Anas will grant Omar access to the SharePoint templates library today.
All department estimates for Q3 budget review must be submitted by Friday with no exceptions.
